name: Tonari no Mono Desu ga
source:
When she comes home, she spots a note her mom left for her...
but it's not what she would expect!
"I made some food for our neighbors. Please, give it to them."
Having read the note, the protagonist is in a hurry.
Reason being, mom's cooking is...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/19087]Freem![/url]]
translation:
当她回到家时，她发现了妈妈留给她的一张纸条……
但这不是她所期望的！
“我为邻居做了一些食物。请给他们吧。”
看完纸条，主角着急了。
原因是，妈妈做的菜是……
